story: I ordered a pair of running shoes on QuickCart on 3 October for ₹2,749 and cancelled two days later, before it shipped. The app showed 'Refund initiated, will reach in 5-7 days'. It never came. I opened a support chat on 14 October and again last week; each time the agent says the refund is 'being processed'. Over a month has gone by and my bank account shows nothing.
